description: This is the main entry point for the OrangeHRM system, handling initial setup, environment configuration, and request processing. It includes configuration and framework initializations, environment detection, and request handling logic.

classes.name: Framework
classes.description: Main application framework handling request routing and response generation.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Handles HTTP request data, created from global variables.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the HTTP response to the client.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Performs any cleanup after request handling.
